overview: You wrote that the friar's letter has miscarried on the way to Mantua, and that you do not have the paper. You do not know the cause, and you did not write one. The vault is not this leaf. There is no song at the door. The red thread stays tied.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the five lines and stopped.
